Settings

Changes are checked, saved to the board's config.json, and the display restarts to use them. Logins go to the board's auth.env and are never shown.

Updates

This board's version, and newer ones from GitHub.

The board restarts as it updates, and so does this page: it comes back by itself in a few minutes (sign in again if it asks). Don't change settings until it's done: a rollback puts config.json back as it was before.
